# Hokvibe

> Hokvibe is a social-content workspace for turning a source idea into editable platform-specific drafts. Customers review every draft before copying it or, where supported, publishing it through a connected account.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://hokvibe.com/) - Product overview and sign-in entry point.
- [Studio](https://hokvibe.com/studio) - Generate, edit, copy, and review drafts.
- [Blog](https://hokvibe.com/blog) - Original guides about content workflows.
- [FAQ](https://hokvibe.com/faq) - Product questions and answers.
- [Privacy](https://hokvibe.com/privacy) - Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://hokvibe.com/terms) - Service terms.

## Machine-Readable Alternatives

- [Root Markdown](https://hokvibe.com/index.md) - Plain Markdown summary of the Hokvibe value proposition.
- [Agent Context](https://hokvibe.com/llms.txt) - This file, designed for autonomous readers and retrieval systems.

## Supported Publishing

- LinkedIn, Facebook Pages, and Reddit may be connected through managed authorization when available in the signed-in workspace.
- X/Twitter, Instagram, and LINE are draft-preview and export formats only.
- Hokvibe does not automatically publish generated content. Customers review and explicitly approve each publication.

## Current Limitations

- A successful generation or connection badge is not proof that content was published.
- Billing and transactional email features are enabled only after their production configuration and verification are complete.
